revisionScope: Last committed base at generation; reviewed working-tree sourcePaths include newer uncommitted native components. Do not infer that all files existed at this base revision.
catalogScope: All 18 current registry source families plus 26 source-grounded missing families; not an exhaustive marketed-model or PCI-ID catalogue.
pciIdPolicy: Every pciDeviceIds array is empty because no per-device macOS compatibility was physically validated. Source-table IDs and chip/product examples are descriptive only.
osTargetPolicy: 15 and 26 are development/build targets; these rows do not assert execution on either OS.

statusVocabulary.partial: Some production components or observation code exist; native hardware owner and full GPU runtime remain incomplete.
statusVocabulary.source_intake: Family/source recipe only; no executable native family backend.
statusVocabulary.not_implemented: Source-grounded missing family profile and native backend; additional planning entry.
statusVocabulary.not_run: No physical native macOS GPU acceptance for this row.
